name: Wide angle (fov 100): lamp-lit avenue to z = 60, thin cables, distant and near spheres
description: Lamp posts, railings and cables only 0.02 units thick receding to 60 units, lanterns at 80 units, a moon at 90 and spheres close to the lens at the image border, seen with fov 100. Checks precision of thin and distant hits and wide-angle framing.
